violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw meat and eggs stored over vegetables in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED THE WALK IN COOLER.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed an employee wash a food container and go to put away without sanitizing the container.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER WARE WASHING AND EMPLOYEE SANITIZED CONTAINER.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: fried squid 75F and noodles wrapped in seaweed 72F after 2.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED BOTTLE OF RAID IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED RAID.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS WITH A GLOVE ON.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER HAND WASHING PROCEDURE AND HAD THE EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS CORRECTLY.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS AT THE PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS EXPLAINED THAT HANDS CAN ONLY BE WASHED AT THE HAND SINK AND HAD EMPLOYEE WASH THEIR HANDS AT THE HAND SINK.
